name: input
purpose: Single-line text input for forms and inline editing. Renders a bordered field with optional leading/trailing icon slots. Visual states (hover, focus, filled) are driven by native CSS pseudo-classes, not props. The component is the field only — labels, helper text, and error messages live in the wrapping form-field layer. Aligned with Figma frame `562:6774` (Webkit / Input).
useWhen: Capture a single line of free-form text (names, titles, search terms).
avoidWhen: The value spans multiple lines → use `textarea`.
The value is strictly numeric → use `number-input`.
The user must choose from a fixed set → use `select` / `multi-select`.
related: number-input` — numeric input with stepper semantics.
field` — wraps this input with label, description and error; the input reads its id, `aria-describedby` and state from it.
bestPractices: Prefer the `field-*` wrapper when you need a label, helper text, or validation message.
Set an appropriate `type`/`inputmode` for the content (email, url, …).
Set `monospace` on a field whose value is code-like: a CLI command, an ID, a token, a hash, a path. Pair it with `:spellcheck="false"`.
A read-only command or ID the user copies: `readonly` + `monospace` inside an `InputGroup` with a `CopyButton`, and a description saying why it cannot change.
Do not set `monospace` on prose values (names, titles, e-mails, domains typed by the user).
Do not restyle a read-only field (dashed border, transparent fill): it is the same filled field, made non-editable; the reason belongs in the field's description.

props.name: modelValue
props.doc: Two-way bound value of the field.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder shown when the field is empty.

props.name: type
props.doc: Native input type. Restricted to single-line variants the field treats identically.

props.name: maxLength
props.doc: Native `maxlength` — maximum number of characters allowed.

props.name: autocomplete
props.doc: Native `autocomplete` token on the `<input>` (e.g. `email`, `username`, `off`). Omitted when unset.

props.name: spellcheck
props.doc: Native `spellcheck` on the `<input>`. Set `false` for slugs, IDs and domains. Omitted when unset: the default is an explicit `undefined`, because Vue would otherwise cast an absent boolean to `false` and render `spellcheck="false"` on every field.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects height only — padding and typography are constant. Heights: small=28px, medium=32px, large=40px.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Marks the field read-only: value is visible, focusable and copyable but not editable. Keeps the filled field (surface and solid border) with no hover border and a default cursor (`data-readonly`); distinct from the disabled field.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required; sets native `required` and `aria-required`. Visual indicator (asterisk) is owned by the wrapping form-field, not by this component.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Applies the invalid border + ring tokens and sets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: monospace
props.doc: Sets the value and placeholder in the monospace code face (`.text-label-code-sm`) for CLI commands, IDs, tokens and hashes (`data-monospace`).

events.name: update:modelValue
events.notes: Emitted on native `input` event with the new value.
